title: resolve_secret_or_literal duplicated in transit and reader s3_store — bug fixes need two edits
description: Scenario: a bug is found in resolve_secret_or_literal (e.g. Windows CRLF handling, secretx error message leaking a secret path, or trim_end_matches needing to be trim). The fix must be applied in both crates/transit/src/peering/s3_store.rs and crates/reader/src/post/s3_store.rs. The maintenance consequence: every future fix or enhancement to secret resolution is a two-file edit. Fix: extract resolve_secret_or_literal into stoa-core (or a shared stoa-util crate) and import from there.
